prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational image edit. Edit the attached terrain infographic, keeping the cinematic Mars editorial style, dark navy/copper palette, cyan highlights and polished panel design. Replace the content with THREE simple panels. Main title exactly 'Terrain sampling and information'. Panel labels exactly '20 m source sampling', '4 m computational grid', 'Local observation footprint'. Add the exact prominent sentence 'Finer numerical sampling does not add orbital detail'. The first two panels must show the SAME coarse terrain information over the SAME extent: left a 5-by-5 coarse color raster, middle that very same 5-by-5 color raster with a finer 25-by-25 thin-line numerical grid superimposed. Every 5-by-5 subdivision in the middle must retain its corresponding one left coarse-cell color; add no new rock, crater, relief, texture or scientific detail between these two panels. A white NoData patch in the same corner must persist in all three panels and be labeled 'NoData'. The third panel shows the same coarse field and a bounded amber circle labeled 'Observation footprint'; no automatic increase in resolution. No kilometer scale bars, no fake georeferenced map, no source measurements, no claims of higher physical resolution or guaranteed accuracy. A subtle generic Martian backdrop may surround the educational grids. No logos, flags, NASA branding or mission insignia. Minimal large text readable at 900 pixels width. Full-width dark footer with exact highly legible text at least 32-pixel font at original scale: 'AI-generated | Conceptual illustration'.

Make one targeted correction to this infographic. Keep ALL titles, words, watermark, borders, colors, backdrop, layout and NoData positions unchanged. Correct ONLY the raster colors in the middle panel: copy the exact same flat 5-by-5 coarse block-color pattern shown in the left panel, in the same row/column order and the same total extent, and overlay exactly five thin grid subdivisions in each coarse-cell direction. Each group of five-by-five fine subcells must have ONE identical flat color corresponding to its original coarse cell on the left. There must be no extra shape, gradient, detail, boundary, texture, smoothing or new terrain information inside any coarse block. White NoData top-right must occupy exactly the same one-coarse-cell area. The middle is only a finer numerical grid drawn over the unchanged coarse information. Do not change the right observation footprint panel. Preserve exact large footer text 'AI-generated | Conceptual illustration'.
